newsitem.title: GERMANY: Adidas leading candidate for DAX, data show.
newsitem.headline: Adidas leading candidate for DAX, data show.

text.p: German sportswear company Adidas AG is a leading candidate to join the DAX index of Germany's 30 leading shares, stastistics published by the Deutsche Boerse showed on Friday.
According to the data, Adidas occupied the 27th position among German companies in terms of market capitalisation and the 29th place in terms of sales.

The figures showed that retailer Karstadt AG could be the company that would be forced out of the DAX to make room for Adidas. Karstadt held the 34th place in sales and the 44th place in capitalisation.
The data measured the companies' performance between July 1, 1996 and June 30, 1997.
The board of the Deutsche Boerse will meet on July 22 to consider changes to the DAX.
In addition to sales and capitalisation, the board aims to achieve a representation of the German economy among DAX-member companies.
